map.雷达反射率估测降水（本页代码口径，Marshall-Palmer）：Z=10^(: Radar reflectivity precipitation estimate (this page's code, Marshall-Palmer): Z=10^(dBZ÷10) (mm⁶/m³); R=(Z÷200)^(1÷1.6) (mm/h); linked values: daily precipitation estimate=R×24, per-minute precipitation=R×60. Validation: no strict checks; empty values count as 0. Grading: echoes tiered by dBZ — <5 no echo, <15 weak echo/drizzle, <25 stratiform light rain, <35 moderate rain, <45 heavy rain/strong precipitation, <50 torrential rain/severe convection, <55 severe torrential, <60 possible hail, otherwise strong hail; precipitation by R — <0.1 no precipitation, <2.5 light, <8 moderate, <16 heavy, <32 torrential, <64 severe torrential, otherwise extraordinary torrential.
